    p.product_id AS assembly_id,
    b.component_id,
    b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
    b.bom_level,

    be.root_product_id,
    b.assembly_id,

    b.bom_level,

)

    -- Find the product_id for FR-M94B-48 from BOM header rows

        p.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        p.make_flag,
        0 AS level,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FR-M94B-48'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively find all components
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_number,
        p.make_flag,
        bt.level + 1,
        bt.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty

WITH RECURSIVE bom_exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: get the product BK-R64Y-40 as the starting assembly
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS root_product_id,
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        p.product_id AS component_id,
        1.0 AS quantity_per_unit,
        0 AS bom_level
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R64Y-40'

        be.root_product_id,

        bom.bom_level

)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(be.quantity_per_unit * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM bom_exploded be
JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE  -- purchased parts only
  AND be.bom_level > 0     -- exclude the root product itself
"}

    -- Recursive: components of manufactured sub-assemblies

        bom.component_id,

    FROM bom_tree bt

    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'

)

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE current_bom AS (
